Sparkforty Affiliate Program

About Sparkforty

Sparkforty creates premium fragrance products designed to elevate everyday spaces. Our collection includes luxury car perfumes, reed diffusers, and home fragrances inspired by sophisticated scents that last. We focus on elegant design, premium ingredients, and memorable fragrance experiences that customers love.

Why Partner With Us?

  • Earn competitive commissions on every qualified sale.

  • Promote premium products with strong visual appeal and repeat purchase potential.

  • Receive your own affiliate link and discount code.

  • Access high-quality product images, lifestyle content, and marketing materials.

  • Work directly with a growing brand that values long-term creator partnerships.

What You'll Promote

  • Luxury Car Perfumes

  • Reed Diffusers

  • Home Fragrances

  • Seasonal Collections

  • Buy One Get One Free promotions and exclusive campaigns

How You Earn

Share your unique affiliate link or coupon with your audience through Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, blogs, or your website. You'll earn a commission on every approved order generated through your referrals.

We're looking for creators in the automotive, lifestyle, home décor, fragrance, luxury, and gifting niches who enjoy sharing quality products with their audience. We review every application individually and look forward to building successful, long-term partnerships.
payout_period: Approved commissions are paid via PayPal or bank transfer on the 10th of each month after the 30-day return period.

term_and_condition:
Welcome to Sparkforty! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals who participate in the Sparkforty Affiliate Program as an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) and to Sparkforty as the merchant (“we,” “us,” or “Sparkforty”).

By participating in the Program, you agree to follow these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program.


1. Program Approval

All affiliate applications are reviewed individually. Sparkforty reserves the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole discretion without providing a reason.

Participation in the Program may also be suspended or terminated if these Terms and Conditions are violated.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes

Approved affiliates receive a unique referral link. Affiliates may also generate referral links for specific Sparkforty products or collections when this feature is available.

Some affiliates may be assigned a personalized coupon code. Coupon details and usage rules will be displayed in the Affiliate Dashboard. Affiliates may only promote coupon codes assigned directly to them by Sparkforty.

If a customer uses both an affiliate referral link and an affiliate coupon code for the same purchase, only one commission will be earned. Double commissions will not be paid on the same order.

Affiliate referrals may be promoted through approved channels including websites, blogs, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, email newsletters, and other legitimate online or offline marketing channels.


3. Commissions

Affiliates earn commissions on eligible purchases made through their referral link or approved affiliate coupon code.

Commission rates are displayed in the Affiliate Dashboard and are calculated based on the applicable commission structure.

Commission calculations are based on the eligible product subtotal and exclude taxes, shipping charges, gift cards where applicable, and other non-product fees.

Sparkforty reserves the right to review referral orders before approving commissions.


4. Payments

To receive commission payments, affiliates must provide accurate and complete payment information in their Affiliate Dashboard.

Payment schedules and available payout methods will be provided through the Affiliate Dashboard or Affiliate Guide.

Payments will only be issued for successfully completed and eligible transactions.

Orders that are canceled, refunded, returned, charged back, fraudulent, duplicated, or otherwise determined to be ineligible will not generate commission. If commission has already been recorded for such an order, Sparkforty reserves the right to reverse or deduct that commission.

Sparkforty may temporarily hold payments while reviewing suspicious activity, disputed transactions, or potential violations of these Terms.


5. Promotional Guidelines

Affiliates are encouraged to promote Sparkforty in an honest, professional, and brand-appropriate manner.

Affiliates may not:

• Make false, misleading, or unsubstantiated claims about Sparkforty or its products.
• Send unsolicited spam or use deceptive marketing practices.
• Impersonate Sparkforty or create websites, domains, social media accounts, or profiles that may be confused with official Sparkforty properties.
• Bid on Sparkforty trademarks, brand names, or confusingly similar terms in paid search advertising without prior written approval.
• Promote unauthorized coupon codes, discounts, or promotions.
• Use misleading advertising that could damage the reputation of Sparkforty.

Affiliates are responsible for complying with all applicable advertising and endorsement laws, including any disclosure requirements that apply to sponsored or affiliate content.


6. Self-Referrals

The Sparkforty Affiliate Program is intended to reward affiliates for referring customers.

Affiliates may not use their own affiliate link or coupon code to earn commissions on their own purchases unless Sparkforty has provided prior written approval.

Attempts to manipulate referral tracking, commissions, coupon usage, or affiliate attribution may result in termination from the Program and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.


7. Cookie and Referral Tracking

Sparkforty uses referral tracking technologies, including browser cookies, to attribute qualifying purchases to affiliates.

The current cookie duration will be displayed on the Affiliate registration page or Affiliate Dashboard.

If a customer disables cookies, deletes cookies, uses privacy tools that block tracking, changes devices or browsers, or otherwise prevents referral tracking, Sparkforty may be unable to attribute the purchase to the affiliate.

Sparkforty cannot guarantee commission for purchases that cannot be accurately tracked by the affiliate platform.

Referral attribution rules, including how multiple affiliate clicks are handled, are determined by the tracking settings configured within the Sparkforty Affiliate Program.


8. Sparkforty Brand and Marketing Materials

Sparkforty may provide approved logos, product images, banners, videos, promotional graphics, or other marketing materials for affiliate use.

Affiliates may use approved Sparkforty marketing materials solely for the purpose of promoting Sparkforty while participating in the Affiliate Program.

All Sparkforty trademarks, logos, product images, photographs, designs, copy, and other intellectual property remain the property of Sparkforty or their respective owners.

Affiliates may not materially alter Sparkforty branding, logos, product packaging, or product representations in a way that is misleading or inconsistent with the brand.


9. Program Changes

Sparkforty reserves the right to modify the Affiliate Program at any time, including commission rates, eligibility requirements, referral tracking rules, cookie duration, payout schedules, promotional guidelines, and these Terms and Conditions.

Updated terms may be posted within the Affiliate Dashboard or otherwise communicated to affiliates. Continued participation in the Program after changes are made constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.


10. Termination

Either Sparkforty or the affiliate may terminate participation in the Affiliate Program at any time.

Sparkforty reserves the right to suspend or terminate an affiliate account for fraudulent activity, abuse of the Program, violations of these Terms, misleading promotion, unauthorized coupon activity, brand misuse, or other conduct that Sparkforty determines is harmful to the Program or brand.

Upon termination, affiliates must stop using Sparkforty affiliate links, coupon codes, and marketing materials where applicable.

If an affiliate wishes to leave the Program, they may contact us at support@sparkforty.com.


11. Contact

If you have any questions about the Sparkforty Affiliate Program or these Terms and Conditions, please contact us at support@sparkforty.com.


Thank you for being part of Sparkforty.

We appreciate your partnership and look forward to growing together.
